label: PF Backlog 466
title: Backlog dedup marking at grooming (possible_duplicate_of) + bulk sweep
body:
Source: user decision (2026-10-07) - Option B for duplicate/overlap handling.

Problem: today near-duplicate ITEMS are only reported ADVISORY (backlog.duplicate_pairs / wired_audit); nothing
links or marks them, so an operator can't see which items are duplicates of which. BI-PF-0422 (A) adds a
claim-time SKIP so at most one of a duplicate set RUNS, but the backlog itself is not annotated.

Scope (B) - whole-backlog near-duplicate MARKING, orchestrated at GROOMING:
- at grooming (`core/grooming.groom` / `decide`): when an item is groomed, compare it to the open backlog
  (reuse `backlog.duplicate_pairs`/`_similarity`) and record `links.possible_duplicate_of = [<canonical id>]`
  (advisory link; do NOT auto-close/block) + surface it in the grooming decision/notes.
- a BULK sweep: `/pf backlog` review (or a scheduled pass) that computes all near-duplicate OPEN pairs
  (reuse `duplicate_pairs`) and marks `possible_duplicate_of` for every non-canonical item.
- surface in `GET /engineering/assignments` and the grooming report so a human resolves (close as `duplicate`,
  merge, or confirm distinct).
- keep the claim-time SKIP (A) as the runtime guard; B is the human-facing marking.

Decisions to confirm: threshold (default 0.6, configurable); canonical = highest-ranked (priority/id); marking
is `links.possible_duplicate_of` (advisory, no status change).

dashboard_impact: no UI surface (operator surface = /pf backlog groom/review + the API).

delivery.note: merged --no-ff; fast precheck PASS (14 gates); 4 tests. Grooming now marks the groomed item only (links.possible_duplicate_of=[canonical]) when a HIGHER-ranked SAME-PROJECT near-duplicate exists (threshold PF_DEDUP_THRESHOLD, default 0.6). Reuses grooming's existing find_similar candidates; advisory only (no status change). Two defects were found and fixed during implementation (see BI-PF-0434 RCCA): candidate id/scope dropped; and cross-project/other-item writes.

analysis.implementation_strategy: Extend existing components/APIs: core/backlog.py, core/backlog_link.py, core/grooming.py, /api/v1/backlog

dashboard_impact.reason: Backlog grooming correctness; no UI surface
